sources.title: Nimbus Cartography Collective: A Brief History
sources.text: The Nimbus Cartography Collective was founded in 2011 by four cartographers working out of a rented loft. It now maintains open elevation datasets for three river basins.

sources.title: Ten years of open maps
sources.text: Nimbus began operations in early 2012, according to its co-founder, and today counts forty-one contributing members across two countries.

sources.title: A note on Nimbus's datasets
sources.text: Nimbus publishes its elevation data under a permissive licence. The collective describes forty-one members as of its most recent report.
